features.title: Hand the right column to a global dock
features.summary: The frame renders the native per-session right sidebar in its right column, or the global dock a plugin registered into the shell.dock seat and asked for through ctx.rightPanel. Swapping the surface keeps the column, its width, drag handle, collapse and fullscreen behaviour, while the occupant reports its own presentation.
failureModes: A frame that offers no seat leaves ctx.rightPanel absent, so a dock plugin stays inert instead of failing.
The column keeps one owner at a time: taking it back restores the native surface.

externalDependencies.boundary: The native right sidebar is the column's default occupant; it reports its own presentation through ctx.layout.openRightbar and closeRightbar, exactly as the dock does.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: The seat's store and mode action are exercised directly in src/right-panel.test.ts; the scratch journey swaps the surface in the browser.

verification.testName: starts on the native surface and follows the reported mode
keeps the column geometry the occupant reported when the surface changes

features.title: Persist the frame's dragged panel widths
features.summary: The layout bundle keeps the dragged sidebar and right-panel widths in the browser, so a reload reopens the sidebar at its last open width and the right panel keeps its px preference while still booting hidden.
failureModes: Malformed or blocked browser storage falls back to the contract default widths.
A stored width outside the drag range is clamped instead of trusted.

verification.testName: reopens the sidebar at its last dragged width and keeps the right panel width
clamps stored widths into the drag range instead of trusting them

features.title: Persist the collapsed sidebar
features.summary: Closing the left sidebar is remembered: a reload boots it collapsed, and reopening restores the last open width instead of the 280px contract default.
failureModes: A narrow frame keeps its own responsive auto-collapse instead of restoring a stored wide-frame override.
A record written before the collapsed flag boots open.

verification.testName: boots collapsed when the last wide state was collapsed, and reopens at the remembered width
writes the collapsed state back and remembers the open width across it
accepts a record written before the collapsed flag and boots open
leaves a narrow frame's auto-collapse to the frame
